messages.content: The flights are now purchased. I want to settle the Boston hotel question. Please compare staying in the symposium room through Sunday with moving to The Verb, including the full personal totals and what Friday would actually look like.

I have the symposium hotel extension at $319 per night for Friday and Saturday. With the quoted 16.45% lodging taxes, the two personal nights total $742.95. The Verb flexible reservation is $548.00 including taxes, so moving saves $194.95. At the symposium hotel, you keep the room and leave your belongings in place. For The Verb, you would check out Friday morning, have the Westin hold the bags, finish the symposium at 3:00 p.m., retrieve them, and take a short cab or rideshare to Fenway for check-in.
There was another nearby alternative too. Put all three on the same basis before we decide.

The third option is Hotel AKA Back Bay at $512.40 including taxes for the same two nights. On a comparable flexible-rate basis: Hotel AKA is $512.40, The Verb is $548.00, and the Westin extension is $742.95. The Westin costs $230.55 more than AKA and $194.95 more than The Verb. None of those totals includes parking, and you will not have a car.
What are the practical differences on Friday? My spouse lands after 1:00 Saturday morning, and I will still be in the final session until 3:00 Friday.

At the Westin, there is no physical checkout or transfer. The front desk would close the employer-paid portion Friday, begin a personal stay on your card, and keep you in the same room. Your spouse can be added to the room and marked for an overnight arrival. At The Verb, you would check out of the Westin before the symposium, store your bags there, collect them after 3:00, and travel about 10 to 20 minutes depending on traffic. The Verb will let you add your spouse and note the late arrival, but the reservation holder should complete check-in first. At Hotel AKA, the transfer is shorter, but the hotel requires either your presence at check-in or a credit-card authorization and guest-access form submitted in advance if your spouse might arrive first.
She will not arrive first if I check in after the session. Is there any reason that authorization matters?

Not if you personally check in Friday afternoon and add her name at the desk. In that sequence, the advance authorization is unnecessary. It only becomes relevant if your session runs late, the room is not ready, or another disruption prevents you from checking in before her overnight arrival.
Compare Saturday access to the Museum of Fine Arts. That is our main plan before the evening flight home Sunday.

The Verb is the easiest of the three for the museum: roughly a 15-minute walk or a short ride. From the Westin, allow about 25 minutes on foot or 10 to 15 minutes by transit or car. Hotel AKA is approximately a 20-minute walk. The Verb therefore has the strongest Saturday location for this itinerary, while the Westin avoids the Friday move.
Now verify the folio issue at the Westin. I cannot have Friday or Saturday appear on the employer bill merely because we keep the same room.

The Westin confirmed that it can split the stay without requiring a room change. On Friday, the front desk can settle the symposium reservation through Friday checkout to the employer card and issue that final folio. It will then create a separate personal continuation for Friday and Saturday nights using your personal card. The hotel described this as linked consecutive reservations, not one folio divided after departure.
Does that mean I need to be at the desk at 11:00 Friday? I cannot leave the program then.

No. The hotel said you may complete the transition before the morning program begins. You would visit the desk Friday morning, review and close the employer folio, present your personal card for the extension, and have the keys refreshed through Sunday. The room remains occupied, so there is no 11:00 a.m. checkout action.
I want the exact documents and charges separated. Be precise.

The employer folio should show the symposium nights from Tuesday through Thursday, with Friday as the departure date, plus only approved business incidentals. The personal confirmation should begin Friday, cover Friday and Saturday nights, and show a Sunday departure. Your personal card should be authorized for $742.95 plus the hotel's incidental hold. Ask for the closed employer folio by email Friday morning and the personal folio after Sunday checkout. Also inspect Thursday night's room charge on the employer folio and Friday night's charge on the personal record before leaving the desk.
Is the $742.95 definitely the complete lodging amount? Earlier I had a slightly different number.

It is the current quoted room-and-tax total: $638.00 in room charges plus $104.95 in taxes. The earlier estimate used a rounded tax calculation. The hotel has not added a destination fee to this rate. The incidental authorization is temporary and is not part of the lodging total, but you should confirm the displayed total again when the linked reservation is created.
For The Verb, would my bags have to sit at the Westin all day, or can they be moved earlier?

The standard plan is to leave them with the Westin bell desk and collect them after the final session. The Verb will accept luggage before check-in, but neither hotel includes transfer service, so you would need to take the bags over yourself in the morning and return to Copley for the program. That adds an unnecessary round trip. Keeping them at the Westin until 3:00 is simpler.
So the real choice is paying about $195 to avoid checkout, bag storage, and a Friday transfer, while giving up The Verb's better museum location.

Correct. The Westin premium is $194.95 over The Verb. It buys uninterrupted room use, no luggage handling, no post-session hotel transfer, and a cleaner overnight-arrival arrangement for your spouse. The Verb saves the money and places you closer to the museum, but Friday requires checkout, bag storage, retrieval, transportation, and a second check-in.

Select the Westin extension. This is a short weekend after a full symposium, and the uninterrupted room is worth the difference. Do not reopen the other options. Give me the exact booking and Friday instructions, but do not book it for me.

Selected, not booked: extend the Westin Copley Place in the same room for Friday and Saturday nights, departing Sunday, at a quoted personal lodging total of $742.95. Have the hotel create a linked personal reservation rather than extending the employer folio. Add your spouse's full name, note the approximately 1:13 a.m. Saturday arrival, and request that she be permitted to receive a key with identification. On Friday morning before the program, close and email the employer folio with a Friday departure, present your personal card for the two-night continuation and incidental hold, refresh both room keys, and verify that Friday night's charge appears only on the personal reservation. Retain both confirmations and both final folios. The only remaining checks are the final taxed total on the personal payment screen and written confirmation that the employer and personal charges are held on separate folios and payment methods.
